rationale: payload() returns the frozen JSON snapshot and refuses non-object; evidence-integrity accessor, no tunable value.

Construction-time fail-closed validation (frozenset type, non-empty strings, target_match vocabulary). The allow-sets are caller/host values already narrowed by M1; the validator is a mandatory guard.
Nine stable PermissionError reason strings are a closed refusal vocabulary consumed by tests/adapter; no policy value.
Missing permissions file yields {} = deny-all; fail-closed default. Making it configurable could only invite fail-open. Permission content itself is host data.
sha256 digest format and derivation equality at the effect transaction: evidence-integrity binding of the effective grant; not variable.
PROFILE_ID and Literal vocabularies are protocol constants/closed vocab for the admission profile.
evaluate_retry always returns False with fixed reasons; no retry policy exists. Reason strings are vocabulary; any future retry policy would be a new rule.
Wrapping destination with IntentRefundDestination when refund_intent is present, refusing invalid type: mandatory binding of intent to effect.
PermissionError converted to denied while retaining refusal/reconciliation evidence; fail-closed error mapping, no threshold.
Status derivation from local result and validated observation enforces lifecycle contract (unknown never carries applied; failed/denied carry none). Evidence semantics.
CLI digest pin check, bounded output (1 MiB), killpg cleanup: integrity/cleanup mechanism. timeout_seconds (1-30) is a separate host-config field, not this record.
Additive sqlite ALTER TABLE column migrations: storage schema mechanism, no policy semantics.
24-field exact-match of claim vs frozen operation: mandatory binding invariant; any relaxation widens.
InProgress is an exception type mapping to unknown outcome. The TTL (dedupe_ttl_seconds) is a destination/provider capability set at _dedupe_init, a different site.
external_send requires an authority record with scope external_send; fixed rule in ordered evaluator, ties action vocabulary to scope. Per-frame allow/block lists are already data.
Rule names and reason texts are the closed trace/refusal vocabulary.
arity_undeclared / measured_exceeds_declared are closed flag codes; declared arities come signed elsewhere.
Field list hashed into obligation_commitment defines the commitment format; changing it breaks verification. max_age_seconds is issuer-signed inside it.
Closed result vocabulary {authorized,hold,deny} checked in verify_record; protocol constant.
RFC 3339 strict grammar is the time-semantics protocol; loosening admits ambiguous instants.
Pydantic strict request schema (amount finite >=0, effects int >=0, defaults 0/1). Request-specific values; actual ceiling comes from grant effective_max_effects.
tenant_id max_length 128 is an identifier-format bound repeated across models and bound into commitments; no owner needs variation, changing it breaks interop.
Observation/reconciliation closed state vocab and safe defaults (retry_eligible/accepted False). ObservationPolicy tolerance default 5 is a separate caller-supplied param.
Write-ahead journal append: persists before exposing, nonce mismatch recorded, default age_basis source_asserted (weakest trust). Evidence integrity.
Clock/stamp helpers (horizon, recorded_at, evaluated_at) for evidence timestamps; no policy value.
4096 cap on _mono_open; eviction drops the monotonic expiry guard (see :1426), so lowering weakens a defence layer; internal memory bound, not policy.
_cached_purpose wiring to pure judge_cached_purpose; age bound comes from class bound (see W7-042). Evaluator.
Context, tenant and identity binding checks: mandatory fail-closed authority-context equality.

owner: Control Plane operator / institution risk owner
rationale: Numeric status-age bounds (status_max_age_seconds default 60; class max_status_age_seconds) are real thresholds; lower = stricter, monotone. Source-selection precedence and N3 extension raising stay in code.
blocking_decision: Does a registry-narrowed age bound also cap N3 outage extensions (else extension widens past it)?

rationale: Policy version/status/binding equality and rule-adoption check are mandatory invariants; the freshness bound it uses is the W7-042 parameter.
Producer key lookup and Ed25519 verify of evidence: signing-root trust path; never migrate.
Purpose status read with cache fallback only when raw is None: fail-closed evaluator logic.
effective_reversibility defaults to strictest (undeclared, protected read, unobservable, window passed -> irreversible); constitutional floor.
judge_cached_purpose refusal order and rules: pure protected evaluator; its bound param is W7-042.
AuthorityHolder kind vocabulary and 256 length limits are schema/closed vocab; holder inventory content is host data covered by commitment.
LocalFileWitness docstring says tests/local use only; 0o644 mode and flock are file mechanics. Chain check (check_witness_chain) is integrity code, retained separately.
allow_incomplete is a per-call argument, default False (safe); caller chooses per invocation, not governed policy.
Default PolicyGate wiring and include_trace=True (trace = evidence) in recorder; gate injectable by caller, rule set is the ordered evaluator (W4-003).
Execute only on allow: mandatory gate-before-effect invariant.
AGT transform handled as hold unless target applied; transformed authorization must bind new commitments. Mandatory binding invariant.
Profile id, upstream revision pin, ENFORCE mode, PRE_TOOL_CALL and limitation text are compatibility/evidence constants; non-ENFORCE would remove a restriction.
Merged operations share an effect budget of one; second effect suppressed. Mandatory duplicate-effect invariant.
CLI argparse surface, strict JSON load, atomic write; interface/serialization. Flags are per-invocation operator args.
Factory, exceptions, re-exports and plain record models: schema/serialization with no policy value.
